bagPolicy.summary: Angel Stadium enforces a clear bag policy to ensure fan safety and expedite entry. Approved bags include clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutches no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) with no obscured interior pockets up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas up to 18” wide
prohibited: Bags and wallets exceeding the size of a small clutch bag (6.5" W x 4.5" H)
Any bag larger than the permissible size (6.5" W x 4.5" H)
bagPolicy.note: Medical and diaper bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Angel Stadium offers thousands of on-site surface parking spaces in lots surrounding the ballpark, with entrances off State College Blvd, Orangewood Ave, and Douglass Rd. Prepaid parking is available through the Angels/Ticketmaster and is cheaper than paying at the gate; lots are cashless. Arrive early as lots fill before first pitch.

rideshare.note: The rideshare pick-up zone is located in the parking lot, directly in front of Gate 1, near the City National Grove of Anaheim building. Rideshare drop-offs should enter through the Orangewood entrance.

concessions.note: Angel Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including a lively Beer Garden with local and popular beers. Highlights include Bridges Grille's Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and signature Garlic Fries, Cadillac Diner's Chili Cheese Hot Dog and Milkshakes, and Coop & Kennel Pub's Pastrami Fry and Crispy Fried Chicken Sub. The Golden Spike Chophouse serves hearty classics like Chicken Tenders & Fries.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Angel Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Angel Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Since tickets retrieved within the MLB Ballpark app will now be considered printed, the tickets will not be available for pickup at Will Call.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Angel Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
